text: cool now inside of the mesh editor side of the app, can you give me a camera lock toggle, so i can set my camera angle, lock it, and it cannot move. i have a habbit of just barely rotating the shit and then getting everyhthing off track from wherre i was lol. need a lock on that por favor
resolution: Built the mesh-editor camera lock the ask describes: set your angle, lock it, and it cannot move. Zig-first — the lock is ONE host-side gate (g_orbit.locked in framework/gpu/3d.zig) sitting exactly where every camera motion funnels, so orbit drag, wheel zoom, pivot pan, double-click focus, AND the orientation-compass snaps all no-op while locked, whether they arrive through the JS doors or engine.zig's native input loop; a stray micro-drag physically cannot nudge the view anymore. New door __model_orbit_lock; ModelView owns the toggle state and re-syncs the host on hot reload. Surfaced three ways: the Lock icon at the end of the mesh action bar (highlights while locked), bare key K in the model keymap, and the Edit menu; the standalone viewer gets a Lock Cam pill. Model-load framing intentionally stays live under lock so opening a model still lands it in view. Proven headless with a new meshops camlock op: camlock:1 + orbit:200,50 renders pixel-identical to the no-orbit baseline (yaw 40 pitch 26 held), while the same orbit unlocked swings to yaw -74 pitch 54 (shots in scratchpad, editor binary compiles ReleaseFast, cart bundles clean).
